projectIdea.idea: A Discord bot that helps organize hackathon teams and manage schedules

concerns: Discord API rate limits for large servers
Database setup might take extra time for beginners
recommendations: Use discord.js library for simplified API interaction
Start with JSON file storage, upgrade to SQLite if time permits
Test with a small test server first
Focus on core features: team creation and basic scheduling

techStack.reasoning: Discord bots are ideal for beginners: single-platform deployment, extensive documentation, and active community support. JSON files eliminate database complexity initially, and Railway offers free hosting with automatic deployments from GitHub.

phases.name: Setup & Bot Registration
phases.description: Create Discord application, set up development environment, and basic bot structure
tasks: Register bot in Discord Developer Portal

phases.name: Core Commands Development
phases.description: Implement team creation, matching, and basic scheduling features
tasks: Add team listing and member display

phases.name: Data Persistence & Testing
phases.description: Implement data storage and test all features thoroughly
tasks: Set up JSON file storage for teams and schedules
Add data validation and error handling
Test all commands in test server
Handle edge cases (empty teams, duplicate members)

phases.name: Deployment & Documentation
phases.description: Deploy bot and create usage documentation
tasks: Deploy to Railway with environment variables

clineTasks.title: Initialize Discord bot project structure
clineTasks.description: Set up a new Node.js project with TypeScript, install discord.js v14, and create the basic bot connection with a test command to verify the bot is working.

clineTasks.title: Implement team creation command
clineTasks.description: Create a slash command /team-create that allows users to create a new team with a name and optional description. Store team data in a JSON file.

clineTasks.title: Implement team join/leave commands
clineTasks.description: Add /team-join and /team-leave commands allowing users to join or leave existing teams. Update the JSON storage accordingly.

clineTasks.title: Create team listing and display
clineTasks.description: Implement /team-list command to show all teams and /team-info to display details about a specific team including members.

clineTasks.title: Build schedule reminder system
clineTasks.description: Create /schedule-add command to set reminders for events. Implement a background task that checks and sends reminders at the scheduled time.

clineTasks.title: Add announcement broadcast feature
clineTasks.description: Implement /announce command (admin only) that broadcasts messages to all registered teams or specific channels.

clineTasks.title: Add data validation and error handling
clineTasks.description: Implement comprehensive error handling for all commands, validate user inputs, and provide helpful error messages.

clineTasks.title: Deploy bot to Railway
clineTasks.description: Set up Railway project, configure environment variables, connect GitHub repository, and deploy the bot with automatic updates.

pitch.title: HackMatch Bot
pitch.tagline: Discord-native team coordination for seamless hackathon collaboration
pitch.problem: Hackathon participants struggle to find teammates and coordinate schedules across different time zones and Discord servers. Manual team formation is chaotic, announcements get lost in busy channels, and important deadlines are missed.
pitch.solution: HackMatch Bot brings structure to hackathon Discord servers with intuitive slash commands for team creation, member matching, schedule management, and targeted announcements. Everything happens in Discord where participants already are, eliminating the need for external tools.
techHighlights: Built with discord.js v14 for modern slash commands and interactions
Simple JSON-based persistence for easy deployment and maintenance
Beginner-friendly codebase that other hackathons can fork and customize
Railway deployment with zero-downtime updates via GitHub integration
